answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Reaching the basalt of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The dawn is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the spiral.
